skills.name: Meeting Review
skills.description: Run a structured multi-perspective review of a topic, proposal, code area, bug, feature, or risky change by producing a decision-ready artifact with trade-offs, preserved behavior, impact radius, and next actions. Use when a user wants cross-functional review signal before deciding, building, shipping, or changing course.
